caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a thick, dark brown metal bar bent into an angular U-shape, with both vertical ends curling outward into circular, spiral-like loops at the top. The horizontal section of the bar arches downward at the center, adding a subtle curvature to its otherwise rigid form. The bottom of the right vertical section is covered by a light gray, weathered material that appears textured and slightly torn, partially enveloping the metal and extending downward irregularly beyond the end of the bar. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with no other objects or elements present. The artist’s signature, "James Daugherty," appears in small printed letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Foot Scraper
